mergeBackMsg: Merge the isolated worktree's changes back into the main directory. The main directory must be clean (no uncommitted changes), or the merge will be rejected.
promoteMsg: Promote the isolated copy to a real branch ({branch} → mj/ prefix) and remove the worktree. Changes stay on the branch, ready to merge or push yourself.
removeMsg: Remove the isolated worktree. Changes that were neither merged nor promoted will be lost for good. Clean up anyway?
mergedBackMsg: Merged back into the main directory
